subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open fork PR for this Debug Snapshots fix, or close/supersede that path and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax, so automation should not create a duplicate fix until that path is resolved.

options.title: Close or supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork PR as superseded, then queue or accept a fresh narrow Control UI fix against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the existing fork branch, repair it for the current Debug page structure, and provide real visual proof before review.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or mark the conflicting fork PR as superseded, then queue or accept a fresh narrow Control UI fix against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the original Debug controller/view surface and is a strong routing candidate for deciding whether to adopt the stale fork path or prefer a fresh current-main fix.
